messages:
Sam: Quick summary from the sessionwe need a compact decision for transports, delta formats, and what counts as a canonical finish. Short thread to lock scope.
Ivy: Recommend supporting both SSE and WS on launch but one canonical delta envelope so parsers remain identical.
Tom: Agree. WS supports control frames (pause/resume, cancel) reliably. SSE support matters for mobile background delivery.
Rhea: Finish reasons: minimal set = completed, max_tokens, cancelled, policy_block, server_error, timeout. Each finish must emit exactly once and include optional reason_details.
Sam: Delta modes: plain_text_v1 (default), ops_v1 (typed ops like insert, function_call), annotated_v1 (provenance + scores). Default = plain_text_v1 to keep runtime simple.
Ivy: Function calls: in ops_v1, deliver as atomic op with call_id and seq when chunked. Clients must be able to reassemble deterministically.
Tom: Resume semantics: handshake returns session_id + resume_token (signed, short TTL). Resume best-effort: try N times, surface success rate metrics.
Rhea: Telemetry: p95 first-delta latency target < 200ms; resume_success >= 90%; ambiguous_finish_rate < 0.5%. These are beta gates.
Sam: SDK acceptance: single final finish event check, no trailing deltas after finish, function_call reassembly, resume roundtrip tests. Mobile: Keychain-backed tokens.
Ivy: Ops: add X-Stream-Allow-Burst header and WS PAUSE/RESUME frames. For SSE send advisory comments and require clients to honor them.
Tom: Rollout: internal dogfood -> invite-only beta with 2 customers -> 10% ramp -> GA. Each step requires SDK releases + dashboards.
Rhea: I'll write finish_reason JSON schema + resume token spec (example tokens). Due Mon.
Sam: I'll own docs: handshake examples for both transports + migration notes for non-streaming apps. Due Tue.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: streaming-handshake-proto v0.3 -> staging 2026-04-08T20:00:00Z :rocket:
Sam: Thanks all, reconvene after staging results.
